tapChoice: Say each picture word. Tap the little word that goes in front of it.
tapChoiceWord: Read each word. Tap the little word that goes in front of it.
notes: Audit of source: each row is one picture, and there are several rows, so each picture word / each word matches the printed K-306 wording better than the singular.
Source says word twice with two meanings (the picture word, then the article). little word separates the article from the picture word for a pre-reader, without the grammar term article.
Kept goes in front of it from the printed K-288 and G1-292 instructions. US spelling; no digits, no quotes.
